release_statuses.validated-course-smoke-not-paper-compara: Manifest-backed synthetic smoke with resolved configuration, provenance, raw rows, and summary; validates the execution path only.
release_statuses.validated-inconclusive-pilot-not-paper-c: Bounded pilot with complete auditable observations whose decision rule did not authorize a paper budget.
release_statuses.validated-input-provenance-not-numeric-r: Checksum- and schema-validated input provenance; does not contain a trained-model result.

policy.note: A CSV is not reproduction evidence merely because it is tracked or rendered in course material.

delta_ablation.csv.reason: Current corrected course-fast rerun, but no complete run manifest or pinned per-instance receipt.

hip_latency.csv.reason: Current Box B integrated parity/latency rows coexist with legacy diagnostics, but no complete run manifest or paper-comparable optimized implementation exists.

hip_benchmark_gfx1201.json.reason: A clean gfx1201 build, fp32/fp16 all-mode parity, and a 30-warmup/100-iteration 1024-squared local run completed, but the receipt explicitly sets directly_comparable=false because the paper does not disclose matching precision, timing, or kernel details.

image_repro_summary.csv.reason: Derived summary includes smoke and incomplete protocol-assumption matrices and is not verified paper evidence.

pink_param_savings.csv.reason: Current corrected Pink course-fast rerun, but no complete run manifest or pinned per-instance receipt.

table1_image.csv.reason: Legacy teaching output; not a complete 24-image paper-exact rerun.

table2_texture.csv.reason: Legacy course-fast data and protocol; not the paper's pinned 18-set 4K run.

table3_sdf.csv.reason: Legacy teaching geometry and protocol; not the four paper assets at 512 cubed.

w10_rate_distortion.csv.reason: Current three-seed matched-size course-fast rerun with schema-v2 packed-rate rows, but no complete run manifest or pinned input receipt.
